text: If you're a business owner with ADHD, this is how you get AI to keep you on task. Every single morning, my AI reads from the agent network brain to understand what projects are currently happening and their statuses. Then it pulls everything from my ClickUp team workspace to understand what's overdue, what's due today, and then what priorities they're all at. Next, it ranks everything by what will actually make the biggest impact on my revenue and urgency and then what unblocks other tasks to do in the future. Once that's done, it reads from this agent brain again to understand the full context and then once it's all ranked, it finds the top five tasks that I need to do today to actually move my business forward. Lastly, it sends a text directly to my phone of the top five things to do today and why and then it logs everything back to the brain so the next session can work from there.
